items.title: Console Teen Gamers
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Show your personality by embodying the colors of your favorite gaming console and become a true Minecraft gamer. Red, blue, green or multicolored choose the color you like the most!

- 20 console teen gamer skins
+ 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Desarrh

items.title: Cave Explorers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Let’s go spelunking! Put on a hard hat with mounted light and discover spectacular sights in Cave Explorers skins. There is a lot to investigate when you role-play with friends hiking through caves that connect, caves with lakes, and deep pits. Gear up in boots and gloves to protect yourself and explore what lies underground!

+ 8 exciting expeditioner HD skins

items.title: Warden Warriors
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Blinder than a bat, and quite a bit more powerful, get ready to attack in Warden Warriors skins. Role-play with friends as you raise your weapons and fight your enemies. Use these intimidating skins as you explore new caves or climb to the top of high cliffs. With your chest armor glowing and throbbing, you will tower above everybody else.

+ 8 mighty mob HD skins

items.title: Crypto Creepers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Cause some real cool techno explosions in Crypto Creepers skins. In colorful patterned designs, role-play with friends and do some digital damage. Become a hostile, high-tech mob as you chase down enemies all over Minecraft. Encrypt your moves so you won’t be detected and show up where you are least expected.

+ 8 advanced detonating HD skins

items.title: Warden Cave Lords
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Be the boss of an underground chamber when you role-play with friends in Warden Cave Lords skins. Rule over a shadowy place as head of this deep dark domain. Big and blinder than a bat, defend your gloomy dripstone home. Choose between powerful looking skins and step up to dominate the dark underworld.

+ 8 unseeing lord and master mobs HD skins

items.title: City Teens 2021
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The year 2021 has already started! But now the new fashion is out!
These teens dress up with the newest style to impress everyone around them.
Have fun and become one of them.

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Western Cowboys
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The west is a lawless place! A place in which only the strongest can persevere! Will you be able to stand your ground or will you crumble under the pressure? Prove yourself and maybe you too can become a legendary cowboy!

- 12 skins
- By Geniely

items.title: Dragon Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
You have always wanted to be a dragon? Now, thanks to these amazing onesies you can, and you can do so stylishly and comfortably! Show off your best look and show your friends how cool you are!

- 8 Teen skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Highschool Youngsters
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Being an American high school can be exhausting. Especially for youngsters fully enjoying their lives with house parties and education. You can do both. Get good grades and have fun!

- 12 skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Palace Guards
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Protect the monarch and the kingdom's vast riches as an elite warrior! Only the best are selected to become part of the revered palace guard! Will you be a part of it?

- 12 Elite fighter skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Teen Pro-Gamer 4
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The 4th Pack of the "Teen Pro-Gamer" Series. Become the ingame hero of your server. With this pack the first step to a pro-gamer career is done!

- 8 Skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Skyblock Giant TNT
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Better watch out when you handle a Flint & Steel in this skyblock world any spark could have explosive consequences! Build your way from island to island and equip yourself to fight the Ender Dragon.

- Have fun playing!

items.title: Hamsters
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
Time has become insanely fun with the arrival of Hamsters. Dress cool or cute in your adventures but if you prefer you can be an animal-loving human and show off your new look to your friends.

+ Includes 3 different hamster and 2 human skins to choose from.

+ By Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Vampire Teens
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Get your spook on with these fashionable undead skins which are perfect for any spine-chilling roleplay. Lurk in the shadows, scare your friends, and hunt for dinner as one of these stylish vampire teens!

+ 10 teen vampire skins

items.title: Ultimate Mini Golf
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Play mini golf with friends on our 18 hole map. Take a golf cart to the nearest hole and earn coins by finishing the holes successfully. You can use these coins to buy cosmetic upgrades or tasty snacks! 

- 18 hole course
- Drive in golf carts
- Cosmetic upgrades 
- Multiplayer friendly
